Targeted pass (198 PDF pages). Loaded (main): gas-driven pneumatic device vent rates (Table 26; same numbers as Clearstone 2018 Table 16, already extracted as clearstone_2018_001), glycol dehydrator THC vent factors per 1000 m3 gas (Table 27, GRI-GLYCalc), heat rates and LHV thermal efficiencies of natural-gas engines by size, turbines, heaters/boilers, catalytic heaters and thermoelectric generators (Table 16), engine/turbine CH4 and N2O combustion factors (Tables 19-20, AP-42), flare N2O factor.
